note: Idaho's 23 no_catalog rows (Clear Creek is filed ID but is on the Sawtooth NF's Raft River division in Utah). 4 added, 19 excluded. Wendover was already in the database (9661) under a different pin, so its row is a duplicate.

added.name: Apgar Campground (Lochsa River, US-12)
